notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/pixtral-large-24-11). It is a product/model catalog page (release month, context 128k, modalities Text/Image input and Text output, MRL license badge, Weights table Parameters 124 / Active 124 / Context 128k, features, deprecation), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header, modality tooltips, Weights tab). The linked blog https://mistral.ai/news/pixtral-large (seed key mistral-pixtral-large-blog) has multimodal benchmarks (MathVista 69.4%, ChartQA, DocVQA, MM-MT-Bench, LMSys Vision ELO) but was not used; seed-lookup listed only this docs document for the card. legal.mistral.ai governance page also not used. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
